@AGENTS.md

## Instruction file routing

`AGENTS.md` is the canonical instruction file for this repository. It is the shared file read by every coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and others); this `CLAUDE.md` exists only to import it, because Claude Code discovers `CLAUDE.md` but not `AGENTS.md`.

When repository guidance needs to be created, corrected, or extended — a new command, a changed architecture note, a convention that turned out to be wrong, anything that would normally be written to `CLAUDE.md` — write it to `AGENTS.md` instead. Do not add instructions to this file, and do not replace this import with generated content (including via `/init`).
